_comment: 10 个 task 的最终 prompt。我逐个看了数据集里的实际画面(外部视角+腕部视角各取 3-6 帧)后重写的。

tasks.old: pick blue cup and put into red cup
tasks.new: pick up the blue cup and place it into the red cup
tasks.scene: 白桌上一个红色塑料杯和一个蓝色塑料杯

tasks.old: Stack one block on the top of another / T1-b-2
tasks.new: stack the red block on top of the blue block
tasks.scene: 一个蓝色长方块 + 一个红色长方块;tix0 和 tix1 是同一个任务的两批采集,已合并为一个 prompt
桌上三个圆形按钮:蓝、白、黄;机器人按蓝色那个

tasks.new: close the lid of the wooden shape sorter box
tasks.scene: 浅色木质形状分类玩具盒(盒面有三角/十字/圆等镂空),盖子敞开,机器人把盖子合上

tasks.scene: 红、蓝、绿三个小方块并排;机器人把朝向不一致的那个转正(不同 episode 转的块不同)

tasks.old: Rotate the red block to make it vertical to the blue block
tasks.new: rotate the red block so that it is perpendicular to the blue block
tasks.scene: 一个蓝色立方块和一个红色立方块竖立在桌上;原文 vertical to 是中式英文,改为 perpendicular to

tasks.new: insert the book into the black book stand

tasks.old: Pull the smaller book out of the shelf
tasks.new: pull the smaller book out of the black book stand
tasks.scene: 与 T4-b 同一套书立,反向操作:把书抽出来。原文 shelf 不准确,实物是书立

tasks.new: pull the small block out from under the large block
tasks.scene: 一大一小两个橙色方块,小的压在大的下面/前面,机器人把小的抽出来
